permissions.reason: Read the DSH live-context mirror under the host temporary directory (/tmp/clm-<session>/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md) before validating and applying a Session.append surface replacement. This declares a location, not a runtime isolation boundary.

permissions.name: oh-my-clm.fs.write
permissions.reason: Write the DSH live-context mirror under the host temporary directory (/tmp/clm-<session>/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.md). Artifacts are outside the workspace and are not isolated by this permission.
